label: Full-doc or out of policy
description: Deals that fall outside low-doc policy: new ABNs, no GST, credit impairment, unusual assets or amounts above the low-doc cap. Not the AssetMX model; a broker with lender relationships is the right channel.

lowDoc.creditFileRequirement: Assessed case by case with full financials

notes: Full financial statements, tax returns and BAS are required.
AssetMX will tell you within the fit check if your deal sits here, so you do not waste time on a low-doc application.
Ask us anyway: policy edges move, and we will say plainly if we cannot help.
